The same record also shows the outage-response weakness remains below target, the mitigation runbook is still draft with missing governance fields, and the current model-card draft omits the flagged limitation. output.claims_about_policy: The governing policy text is the limiting factor. It says certification without material caveats requires either current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The admissible record does not show either condition has been met. It does, however, support compliance on a caveated basis because the disclosure policy separately permits launch where a material limitation is disclosed unless and until it is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance. Draft monitoring and runbook materials can support risk management, but they do not clear the disclosure obligation on their own.
